extracted.name: Chipotle Ranch Dressing
extracted.description: This chipotle ranch dressing is creamy, tangy, smoky, spicy, and SO easy to make! I love to slather it onto veggies burgers, serve it as a dipping sauce, and more. Find specific serving suggestions in the post above.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup whole milk Greek yogurt
1 chipotle pepper from a can of chipotles in adobo sauce
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the yogurt, mayo, chipotle pepper, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, dill, salt, and blend until smooth.
